description: This file defines the TreeView widget class and related classes for creating and managing a tree structure in a web UI, including animation effects and node management.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.TreeView
classes.description: Main class for creating and managing a tree structure, including node registration, event handling, and animation control.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the tree, with properties and methods for expansion, collapse, and rendering.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.RootNode
classes.description: Specialized Node representing the root of the tree.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.TextNode
classes.description: A node with a text label, extending Node.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.MenuNode
classes.description: A specialized TextNode with menu capabilities.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.HTMLNode
classes.description: A node that contains HTML content.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.TVAnim
classes.description: Factory for animation effects used in expand/collapse actions.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.TVFadeIn
classes.description: Animation class for fading in elements.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.TVFadeOut
classes.description: Animation class for fading out elements.

methods.name: setExpandAnim
methods.description: Sets the animation type for expanding nodes.

methods.name: setCollapseAnim
methods.description: Sets the animation type for collapsing nodes.

methods.name: animateExpand
methods.description: Performs expand animation on a node.

methods.name: animateCollapse
methods.description: Performs collapse animation on a node.

methods.name: expandComplete
methods.description: Callback when expand animation completes.

methods.name: collapseComplete
methods.description: Callback when collapse animation completes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the TreeView with a given ID.

methods.name: getEl
methods.description: Returns the DOM element of the tree.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the tree HTML.

methods.name: regNode
methods.description: Registers a node within the tree.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root node.

methods.name: setDynamicLoad
methods.description: Sets a dynamic data loader for nodes.

methods.name: expandAll
methods.description: Expands all nodes.

methods.name: collapseAll
methods.description: Collapses all nodes.

methods.name: getNodeByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a node by its index.

methods.name: getNodeByProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a node by a property value.

methods.name: getNodesByProperty
methods.description: Retrieves multiple nodes matching a property value.

methods.name: removeNode
methods.description: Removes a node from the tree.

methods.name: removeChildren
methods.description: Removes all children of a node.

methods.name: _deleteNode
methods.description: Deletes a node and its children.

methods.name: popNode
methods.description: Removes a node from its parent.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a node.

methods.name: onExpand
methods.description: Event callback for node expansion.

methods.name: onCollapse
methods.description: Event callback for node collapse.
